name: Association Audit
description: Community passive audit plugin that records advisory request/response association signals in plugin audit logs. Requires a configured api_key provider with claude or codex CLI key before enabling.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Controls whether passive association audit runs for gateway traces.

providerId.title: Provider ID
providerId.description: Host provider id used for model.invoke. Must be an enabled api_key provider with claude or codex CLI key. Empty or non-positive values keep audit calls disabled.

model.title: Model
model.description: Provider model name used by the host-mediated audit call. Uses the raw model name, not provider aliases.

sampleRate.title: Sample Rate
sampleRate.description: Percentage of traces selected when mode is sampled.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout Seconds
timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum duration for the host-mediated audit model call.

maxInputChars.title: Max Input Chars
maxInputChars.description: Maximum redacted request characters included in the audit package.

maxOutputChars.title: Max Output Chars
maxOutputChars.description: Maximum redacted response characters included in the audit package.
